newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Woolworth Cyprus supermarket talks off.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth Cyprus supermarket talks off.

text.p: Negotiations between Woolworth Cyprus for the acquisition of the Charalambides Hypermarket operations in Nicosia have fallen through, a Woolworth statement said on Tuesday.
The company did not offer any reasons. It said lawyers for Charalambides informed the Woolworth group of their decision earlier Tuesday.
The Charalambides Hypermarket, which opened late last year, is one of the largest in the capital.
Woolworth Cyprus, a wholly-owned subsidiary of N.K.S. Shakolas (Holdings) Ltd., has five department stores on the island and is scheduled to open a sixth store in Nicosia later this year.
